import copy,json,sys,unittest
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,'tools/behavior-tests')
import test_terraform_height_browser_audit as t
D=Path('/tmp/terraform-land-height-v6-second')
raw=(D/'application.log').read_bytes(); records=t.audit.parse_records(raw); report=json.loads((D/'report.json').read_bytes())
class ChangedRetainedCases(unittest.TestCase):
 def test_remote_boolean_height_cannot_be_typed_map_evidence(self):
  r,q=copy.deepcopy((records,report))
  packets=[v for k,v,_ in r if k=='TH_NATIVE']
  for p in packets:p['world']['terrain_trace']['tiles']['0,0']['elevation']['center']=True
  for item,p in zip(q['native_snapshots'],packets):item['observation']=t.audit.node_projection(p)
  with self.assertRaises(AssertionError):t.audit.audit_records(r,q)
 def test_contradictory_native_ui_projection_cannot_be_dropped(self):
  r,q=copy.deepcopy((records,report));packets=[v for k,v,_ in r if k=='TH_NATIVE']
  for p in packets:p['world']['terrain_trace']['ui']['selected']=999
  for item,p in zip(q['native_snapshots'],packets):item['observation']=t.audit.node_projection(p)
  with self.assertRaisesRegex(AssertionError,'duplicated native UI'):t.audit.audit_records(r,q)
 def test_available_mirrors_and_unobservable_base_identity(self):
  x=t.ActualCaptureAuditTests();x.original=(records,report);x.setUp();x.test_reject_swapped_native_unit_and_base_detail_mirrors()
r=unittest.TextTestRunner(verbosity=2).run(unittest.defaultTestLoader.loadTestsFromTestCase(ChangedRetainedCases));assert not r.skipped
raise SystemExit(not r.wasSuccessful())
